CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   D. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   C. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   D. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   C. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   D. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   C. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Prophecies about the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain John the Baptist to the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Forms of Worship 6 5.2 Role of the Church in Education and Health 5 6.0 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. A — Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. D — Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. B — Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prophecies about the Messiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of John the Baptist to the Messiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Forms of Worship 6 5.2 Role of the Church in Education and Health 5 6.0; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
